name: Damage Inc.
caption: A managed tag team that won a five-man handicap main event on the federation's first card back.

identity.note: A common tag-team name; no evidence ties this federation's own team to any of these other promotions' own Damage Inc./Damage Incorporated. (A same-named unit at another 2002 wing was also found on re-check.)

tenures.source: Billed on the promotion's own cards.

name: Knock Down Drag Out
caption: A tag team that lost a round-robin match to Damage Inc. on the federation's 27 February 2002 card.

tenures.source: Billed on the promotion's own cards.

name: The Deities
caption: A stable led by The Prophet, introduced to the federation on its 29 September 2002 roleplay show.

identity.note: The same wing's own Prophet leads a DIFFERENT trio under this identical stable name at a different point in its own continuity (the Nelson brothers, once turned); this federation's own Deities are the Prophet's earlier "2001: Fear" members (Wasted Youth, Suicide Kid) plus a new recruit, not the Nelson brothers.

tenures.source: Billed on the promotion's own cards.

name: Bad Element
caption: A tag team of T-Bone and Tommy Jackal, formed after their earlier NIWF singles debuts, that lost a tag team cage match at Bad Intentions.

tenures.source: Billed on the promotion's own cards.

name: The Red Bomb Dragons
caption: A tag team of Tiger Kwon and Jimmy Wing that lost a handicap match to Xanthos.

tenures.source: Billed on the promotion's own cards.

name: Da Bomb Squad
caption: A tag pairing of Brad Baggs and Sean Steele, introduced on the 27 October 2002 Mayhem card.

identity.note: A similar but not identical tag-team name shared with other promotions' own Bomb Squad teams; no evidence of overlap.

tenures.source: Billed on the promotion's own cards.

name: Windham & Graves
caption: A tag pairing of Dennis Windham and Graves that defeated Bad Element on the 2 November 2002 Mayhem card.

tenures.source: Billed on the promotion's own cards.
